Population increased in Kent

The estimated population of Kent in 2024 was 1,639,029 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Kent increased by 3.8%.

Age profile of Kent

The average (median) age fell to 42.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Kent has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Kent's population of 1,639,029 usual residents was made up of:

  • 314,058 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.2%)
  • 989,007 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.3%)
  • 335,964 people aged 65 years and over, (20.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Kent has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (60.3% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Kent, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Kent
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Kent, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 397 people (0%). In total, there were 15,565 births and 15,962 deaths in Kent.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 9,333 (0.6%). There were 69,445 people entering the area and 60,112 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Kent's population of 12,688 (0.8%) as a result of 20,590 people entering the area and 7,902 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Kent was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Kent in mid-2023 is 1,617,585.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 4,511 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 2,823 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 7,334 people.
